lines: kṛṣṇa jinakā nāma hai, gokula jinakā dhāma hai
content.translation: He whose name is Kṛṣṇa, and whose abode is Gokula — unto such a Supreme Personality of Godhead, I offer my most humble obeisances, again and again.

lines: yaśodā jinakī maiyā hai, nanda jī bāpaiyā hai
content.translation: He whose mother is Yaśodā, and whose father is Nandajī — unto such a cowherd boy named Gopāla, I offer my most humble obeisances, again and again.

lines: rādhā jinakī chāyā hai, adbhuta jinakī māyā hai
content.translation: He whose Beloved is Rādhā, and whose illusory energy is very amazing — unto He whose splendrous complexion is the color of the fresh raincloud, I offer my most humble obeisances, again and again.

lines: lūṭa lūṭa dadhi mākhana khāyo, gvāla-bāla sańga dhenu carāyo
content.translation: He who sneaks around to steal yogurt and butter, then hides to eat it, and who tends the cows in the company of His cowherd boyfriends — unto He who is the reservoir of playful pastimes, I offer my most humble obeisances, again and again.

lines: drupada sutā ki lāja bacāyo, grāha se gaja ko phanda chudāyo
content.translation: He who prevented the dishonoring of the daughter of King Drupada, and who delivered the elephant Gajendra from the grasp of the alligator — unto He who is the abode of all compassion, I offer my most humble obeisances, again and again.

lines: kuru pāṇḍava me yuddha macāyo, arjuna ko upadeśa sunāyo
content.translation: He who caused the great war between the Kurus and the Pāṇḍavas, and who spoke divine instructions to Arjuna on the battlefield — unto He who is the Lord of all helpless fallen souls, I offer my most humble obeisances, again and again.

lines: bhaja re! bhaja govinda gopāla hare
rādhe govinda, rādhe govinda, rādhe govinda
rādhe gopāla, rādhe gopāla, rādhe gopāla
